title: अशीतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 80 · Narada begins the tour of the sacred fords

summary.en: Narada visits the Pandavas and recounts how Pulastya once taught Bhishma the merit of pilgrimage. Pulastya begins to list the holy places, beginning with Pushkara, and the rewards of bathing at each.
summary.kn: ನಾರದರು ಪಾಂಡವರನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದೆ ಪುಲಸ್ತ್ಯರು ಭೀಷ್ಮನಿಗೆ ತೀರ್ಥಯಾತ್ರೆಯ ಪುಣ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉಪದೇಶಿಸಿದ್ದನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪುಷ್ಕರದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ ಪುಣ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳನ್ನೂ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ನಾನದ ಫಲವನ್ನೂ ಪುಲಸ್ತ್ಯರು ಪಟ್ಟಿಮಾಡತೊಡಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: नारद पाण्डवों से मिलकर बताते हैं कि पुलस्त्य ने कभी भीष्म को तीर्थयात्रा का पुण्य सिखाया था। पुलस्त्य पुष्कर से आरम्भ कर पवित्र स्थानों और वहाँ स्नान के फलों को गिनाने लगते हैं।
summary.te: నారదుడు పాండవులను సందర్శించి ఒకప్పుడు పులస్త్యుడు భీష్మునికి తీర్థయాత్ర పుణ్యాన్ని ఉపదేశించినది చెబుతాడు. పుష్కరంతో మొదలుపెట్టి పుణ్యక్షేత్రాలను, అక్కడ స్నాన ఫలాలను పులస్త్యుడు ఏకరువు పెడతాడు.
summary.ta: நாரதர் பாண்டவர்களைச் சந்தித்து, முன்பு புலஸ்த்யர் பீஷ்மருக்குத் தீர்த்தயாத்திரையின் புண்ணியத்தைப் போதித்ததைச் சொல்கிறார். புஷ்கரம் முதலாகப் புனிதத் தலங்களையும் அங்கு நீராடுவதன் பலன்களையும் புலஸ்த்யர் பட்டியலிடத் தொடங்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: പുലസ്ത്യൻ ഭീഷ്മരെ തീർത്ഥയാത്രയുടെ പുണ്യം പഠിപ്പിച്ച പഴയ കഥ നാരദൻ പാണ്ഡവരോട് പറയുന്നു. പുഷ്കരം മുതൽ തുടങ്ങി പുണ്യസ്ഥലങ്ങളുടെ പട്ടിക പുലസ്ത്യൻ പറഞ്ഞുതുടങ്ങുന്നു; ഓരോ തീർത്ഥത്തിലും സ്നാനം ചെയ്യുന്നതിന്റെ ഫലവും അദ്ദേഹം വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.80; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
धनंजयोत्सुकास्ते तु वने तस्मिन्महारथाः ।
न्यवसन्त महाभागा द्रौपद्या सह पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Longing for Dhananjaya, those blessed great warriors, the Pandavas, lived on in that forest with Draupadi.

verses.text:
अथापश्यन्महात्मानं देवर्षिं तत्र नारदम् ।
दीप्यमानं श्रिया ब्राह्म्या दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसम् ॥

meaning.en: Then they saw the great-souled divine sage Narada there, blazing with Brahmic radiance and with the brilliance of a kindled fire.

verses.text:
स तैः परिवृतः श्रीमान्भ्रातृभिः कुरुसत्तमः ।
विबभावतिदीप्तौजा देवैरिव शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by his brothers, that glorious best of the Kurus, of dazzling vigour, shone like Indra among the gods.

verses.text:
यथा च वेदान्सावित्री याज्ञसेनी तथा सती ।
न जहौ धर्मतः पार्थान्मेरुमर्कप्रभा यथा ॥

meaning.en: And Draupadi, daughter of Yajnasena, devoted as Savitri is to the Vedas, never left the Pandavas in dharma, as the sun's light never leaves Mount Meru.

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां नारदो भगवानृषिः ।
आश्वासयद्धर्मसुतं युक्तरूपमिवानघ ॥

meaning.en: Having accepted their worship, the blessed sage Narada comforted Dharma's son, Yudhishthira, in fitting words, O blameless one.

verses.text:
उवाच च महात्मानं धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
ब्रूहि धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ केनार्थः किं ददामि ते ॥

meaning.en: He said to the great-souled king of dharma, Yudhishthira, "Best of those who uphold dharma, tell me what you need. What shall I give you?"

verses.text:
अथ धर्मसुतो राजा प्रणम्य भ्रातृभिः सह ।
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं नारदं देवसंमितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king, son of Dharma, bowed with his brothers and, with folded hands, spoke to Narada, who was like a god.

verses.text:
त्वयि तुष्टे महाभाग सर्वलोकाभिपूजिते ।
कृतमित्येव मन्येऽहं प्रसादात्तव सुव्रत ॥

meaning.en: Great sage, honoured by all the worlds, when you are pleased I count my purpose as already achieved, by your grace, firm in your vows.

verses.text:
यदि त्वहमनुग्राह्यो भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघ ।
संदेहं मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ हृदिस्थं छेत्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: If you will favour me and my brothers, blameless sage, best of munis, please cut the doubt that lies in my heart.

verses.text:
प्रदक्षिणं यः कुरुते पृथिवीं तीर्थतत्परः ।
किं फलं तस्य कार्त्स्न्येन तद्ब्रह्मन्वक्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: What fruit does a man gain who goes around the whole earth, devoted to visiting holy fords? Brahmin, please tell me it fully.

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
शृणु राजन्नवहितो यथा भीष्मेण भारत ।
पुलस्त्यस्य सकाशाद्वै सर्वमेतदुपश्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Listen attentively, king, O Bharata, to how Bhishma heard all this from Pulastya.

verses.text:
पुरा भागीरथीतीरे भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः ।
पित्र्यं व्रतं समास्थाय न्यवसन्मुनिवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, on the bank of the Bhagirathi, Bhishma, best of dharma's upholders, lived like a sage, keeping a vow in honour of his father.

verses.text:
शुभे देशे महाराज पुण्ये देवर्षिसेविते ।
गङ्गाद्वारे महातेजा देवगन्धर्वसेविते ॥

meaning.en: He lived at Gangadvara, a holy and lovely place, O great king, frequented by divine sages, gods and gandharvas.

verses.text:
स पितॄंस्तर्पयामास देवांश्च परमद्युतिः ।
ऋषींश्च तोषयामास विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: That supremely radiant man satisfied the ancestors and gods with water offerings, and pleased the sages, by the rites laid down.

verses.text:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य जपन्नेव महातपाः ।
ददर्शाद्भुतसंकाशं पुलस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: After some time, as he was murmuring prayers, the great ascetic saw Pulastya, best of sages, who appeared wondrous.

verses.text:
स तं दृष्ट्वोग्रतपसं दीप्यमानमिव श्रिया ।
प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे विस्मयं च परं ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him of fierce austerity, blazing with glory, Bhishma felt unmatched joy and great wonder.

verses.text:
उपस्थितं महाराज पूजयामास भारत ।
भीष्मो धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: When the sage arrived, O great king, Bhishma, best of dharma's upholders, worshipped him by the proper rite.

verses.text:
शिरसा चार्घ्यमादाय शुचिः प्रयतमानसः ।
नाम संकीर्तयामास तस्मिन्ब्रह्मर्षिसत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: Pure and composed, he took the guest-offering on his head and spoke his own name to that best of Brahmin sages.

verses.text:
भीष्मोऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते दासोऽस्मि तव सुव्रत ।
तव संदर्शनादेव मुक्तोऽहं सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥

meaning.en: "I am Bhishma. May good fortune be yours. I am your servant, firm in vows. By the mere sight of you I am freed from all sins."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज भीष्मो धर्मभृतां वरः ।
वाग्यतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तूष्णीमासीद्युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, O great king, Bhishma, best of dharma's upholders, folded his hands, restrained his speech and stayed silent, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा नियमेनाथ स्वाध्यायाम्नायकर्शितम् ।
भीष्मं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठं मुनिः प्रीतमनाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhishma, best of the Kuru line, worn thin by discipline and by study and tradition, the sage was pleased.

verses.text: पुलस्त्य उवाच

meaning.en: Pulastya said:

verses.text:
अनेन तव धर्मज्ञ प्रश्रयेण दमेन च ।
सत्येन च महाभाग तुष्टोऽस्मि तव सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Knower of dharma, I am pleased with you in every way, with this humility, self-control and truthfulness.

verses.text:
यस्येदृशस्ते धर्मोऽयं पितृभक्त्याश्रितोऽनघ ।
तेन पश्यसि मां पुत्र प्रीतिश्चापि मम त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: Because you hold such a dharma, grounded in devotion to your father, you see me, my son, and I too feel affection for you.

verses.text:
अमोघदर्शी भीष्माहं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते ।
यद्वक्ष्यसि कुरुश्रेष्ठ तस्य दातास्मि तेऽनघ ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma, my sight never goes in vain. Tell me what I can do for you. Whatever you ask, best of the Kurus, I will grant, blameless one.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
प्रीते त्वयि महाभाग सर्वलोकाभिपूजिते ।
कृतमित्येव मन्येऽहं यदहं दृष्टवान्प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: Great sage, honoured by all the worlds, when you are pleased I consider my purpose fulfilled, since I have seen my lord.

verses.text:
यदि त्वहमनुग्राह्यस्तव धर्मभृतां वर ।
वक्ष्यामि हृत्स्थं संदेहं तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: If you will favour me, best of upholders of dharma, I will state the doubt in my heart, and you should answer it.

verses.text:
अस्ति मे भगवन्कश्चित्तीर्थेभ्यो धर्मसंशयः ।
तमहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि पृथक्संकीर्तितं त्वया ॥

meaning.en: Blessed sir, I have a doubt about dharma concerning holy fords, and I wish to hear it explained by you, one by one.

verses.text:
प्रदक्षिणं यः पृथिवीं करोत्यमितविक्रम ।
किं फलं तस्य विप्रर्षे तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन ॥

meaning.en: Of boundless valour, what fruit does a man gain who circles the earth? Tell me that, brahmin sage, rich in austerity.

verses.text: पुलस्त्य उवाच

meaning.en: Pulastya said:

verses.text:
हन्त तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि यदृषीणां परायणम् ।
तदेकाग्रमनास्तात शृणु तीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ॥

meaning.en: Gladly I will tell you what is the sages' supreme refuge. Listen with a focused mind, my son, to the fruit gained at holy fords.

verses.text:
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश्चैव सुसंयतम् ।
विद्या तपश्च कीर्तिश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: One whose hands, feet and mind are well controlled, and who has knowledge, austerity and good repute, gains the fruit of the fords.

verses.text:
प्रतिग्रहादुपावृत्तः संतुष्टो नियतः शुचिः ।
अहंकारनिवृत्तश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: One who has turned away from accepting gifts, who is content, disciplined and pure, and free of egotism, gains the fruit of the fords.

verses.text:
अकल्कको निरारम्भो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः ।
विमुक्तः सर्वदोषैर्यः स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: One who is without deceit, who undertakes no ventures, eats lightly, has mastered his senses and is free of all faults, gains the fruit of the fords.

verses.text:
अक्रोधनश्च राजेन्द्र सत्यशीलो दृढव्रतः ।
आत्मोपमश्च भूतेषु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: King of kings, one who is free of anger, truthful by nature, firm in vows and treats all beings as himself, gains the fruit of the fords.

verses.text:
ऋषिभिः क्रतवः प्रोक्ता वेदेष्विह यथाक्रमम् ।
फलं चैव यथातत्त्वं प्रेत्य चेह च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: The sages have set out the sacrifices in the Vedas in due order, with their fruit, in this world and the next, as they truly are.

verses.text:
न ते शक्या दरिद्रेण यज्ञाः प्राप्तुं महीपते ।
बहूपकरणा यज्ञा नानासंभारविस्तराः ॥

meaning.en: But, lord of the earth, a poor man cannot perform those sacrifices, which need many implements and wide-ranging preparations.

verses.text:
प्राप्यन्ते पार्थिवैरेते समृद्धैर्वा नरैः क्वचित् ।
नार्थन्यूनोपकरणैरेकात्मभिरसंहतैः ॥

meaning.en: Kings or the wealthy can sometimes perform them, but not men of scanty means, alone and without support.

verses.text:
यो दरिद्रैरपि विधिः शक्यः प्राप्तुं नरेश्वर ।
तुल्यो यज्ञफलैः पुण्यैस्तं निबोध युधां वर ॥

meaning.en: Best of fighters, listen to the rule which even the poor can follow, equal in merit to the fruits of sacrifices.

verses.text:
ऋषीणां परमं गुह्यमिदं भरतसत्तम ।
तीर्थाभिगमनं पुण्यं यज्ञैरपि विशिष्यते ॥

meaning.en: This is the highest secret of the sages, best of the Bharatas: the holy practice of visiting holy fords, which even excels sacrifices.

verses.text:
अनुपोष्य त्रिरात्राणि तीर्थान्यनभिगम्य च ।
अदत्त्वा काञ्चनं गाश्च दरिद्रो नाम जायते ॥

meaning.en: One who has not fasted for three nights, not visited the holy fords and not given gold and cows is born poor.

verses.text:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा विपुलदक्षिणैः ।
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति तीर्थाभिगमनेन यत् ॥

meaning.en: A man who has performed Agnishtoma and other sacrifices with large fees does not gain the fruit that visiting the fords brings.

verses.text:
नृलोके देवदेवस्य तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ।
पुष्करं नाम विख्यातं महाभागः समाविशेत् ॥

meaning.en: In the world of men there is a ford of the God of gods, famous in the three worlds, known as Pushkara. A fortunate man should go to it.

verses.text:
दश कोटिसहस्राणि तीर्थानां वै महीपते ।
सांनिध्यं पुष्करे येषां त्रिसंध्यं कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Ten thousand crores of fords, O king, joy of the Kurus, are present at Pushkara at the three twilights.

verses.text:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याश्च समरुद्गणाः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव नित्यं संनिहिता विभो ॥

meaning.en: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sadhyas, the Maruts, gandharvas and apsaras are always present there, O mighty one.

verses.text:
यत्र देवास्तपस्तप्त्वा दैत्या ब्रह्मर्षयस्तथा ।
दिव्ययोगा महाराज पुण्येन महतान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: There gods, daityas and brahmin sages practised austerity and, endowed with divine yoga, attained great merit, O great king.

verses.text:
मनसाप्यभिकामस्य पुष्कराणि मनस्विनः ।
पूयन्ते सर्वपापानि नाकपृष्ठे च पूज्यते ॥

meaning.en: For a resolute man who merely wishes in his mind to go to Pushkara, all sins are cleansed, and he is honoured in heaven.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाभाग नित्यमेव पितामहः ।
उवास परमप्रीतो देवदानवसंमतः ॥

meaning.en: Blessed one, at that ford the Grandfather, Brahma, always dwells, very pleased and approved by gods and danavas.

verses.text:
पुष्करेषु महाभाग देवाः सर्षिपुरोगमाः ।
सिद्धिं समभिसंप्राप्ताः पुण्येन महतान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: At Pushkara the gods, led by the sages, attained perfection, endowed with great merit.

verses.text:
तत्राभिषेकं यः कुर्यात्पितृदेवार्चने रतः ।
अश्वमेधं दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wise say that one who bathes there, devoted to honouring ancestors and gods, gains ten times the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
अप्येकं भोजयेद्विप्रं पुष्करारण्यमाश्रितः ।
तेनासौ कर्मणा भीष्म प्रेत्य चेह च मोदते ॥

meaning.en: Even if he feeds only a single brahmin when he stays in the Pushkara forest, Bhishma, he rejoices for that deed here and after death.

verses.text:
शाकमूलफलैर्वापि येन वर्तयते स्वयम् ।
तद्वै दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय श्रद्धावाननसूयकः ।
तेनैव प्राप्नुयात्प्राज्ञो हयमेधफलं नरः ॥

meaning.en: Whatever vegetables, roots or fruits one lives on oneself, if one gives that to a brahmin with faith and without envy, a wise man will gain the fruit of a horse sacrifice by that alone.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा राजसत्तम ।
न वियोनिं व्रजन्त्येते स्नातास्तीर्थे महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin, kshatriya, vaishya or shudra, best of kings, who bathes at that great soul's ford is not born in a lower womb.

verses.text:
कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषेण योऽभिगच्छेत पुष्करम् ।
फलं तत्राक्षयं तस्य वर्धते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: One who goes to Pushkara especially on the full moon of Kartika has an imperishable fruit there that keeps growing, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
सायं प्रातः स्मरेद्यस्तु पुष्कराणि कृताञ्जलिः ।
उपस्पृष्टं भवेत्तेन सर्वतीर्थेषु भारत ।
प्राप्नुयाच्च नरो लोकान्ब्रह्मणः सदनेऽक्षयान् ॥

meaning.en: One who with folded hands remembers Pushkara morning and evening is deemed to have bathed at all fords, O Bharata, and will gain imperishable worlds in Brahma's abode.

verses.text:
जन्मप्रभृति यत्पापं स्त्रियो वा पुरुषस्य वा ।
पुष्करे स्नातमात्रस्य सर्वमेव प्रणश्यति ॥

meaning.en: All the sins a woman or man has committed since birth are entirely destroyed by merely bathing at Pushkara.

verses.text:
यथा सुराणां सर्वेषामादिस्तु मधुसूदनः ।
तथैव पुष्करं राजंस्तीर्थानामादिरुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: As Madhusudana is the first of all the gods, so Pushkara is said to be the first of holy fords, O king.

verses.text:
उष्य द्वादश वर्षाणि पुष्करे नियतः शुचिः ।
क्रतून्सर्वानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: One who lives twelve years at Pushkara, disciplined and pure, gains all sacrifices and goes to Brahma's world.

verses.text:
यस्तु वर्षशतं पूर्णमग्निहोत्रमुपासते ।
कार्त्तिकीं वा वसेदेकां पुष्करे सममेव तत् ॥

meaning.en: One who tends the sacred fire for a full hundred years gains merit equal to staying a single Kartika full moon at Pushkara.

verses.text:
दुष्करं पुष्करं गन्तुं दुष्करं पुष्करे तपः ।
दुष्करं पुष्करे दानं वस्तुं चैव सुदुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: It is hard to reach Pushkara, hard to perform austerity at Pushkara, hard to give gifts at Pushkara, and very hard indeed to live there.

verses.text:
उष्य द्वादशरात्रं तु नियतो नियताशनः ।
प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्तो जम्बूमार्गं समाविशेत् ॥

meaning.en: After staying twelve nights, restrained and with restrained diet, one should circle the place and enter Jambumarga.

verses.text:
जम्बूमार्गं समाविश्य देवर्षिपितृसेवितम् ।
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विष्णुलोकं च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Entering Jambumarga, frequented by divine sages and ancestors, one gains the horse sacrifice and goes to Vishnu's world.

verses.text:
तत्रोष्य रजनीः पञ्च षष्ठकालक्षमी नरः ।
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति सिद्धिं प्राप्नोति चोत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: A man who stays five nights there, taking food only at the sixth mealtime, does not meet an evil fate and attains the highest success.

verses.text:
जम्बूमार्गादुपावृत्तो गच्छेत्तण्डुलिकाश्रमम् ।
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोके च पूज्यते ॥

meaning.en: Returning from Jambumarga, one should go to Tandulika's hermitage; one does not meet an evil fate and is honoured in heaven.

verses.text:
अगस्त्यसर आसाद्य पितृदेवार्चने रतः ।
त्रिरात्रोपोषितो राजन्नग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Agastya's lake, devoted to honouring ancestors and gods, a man who fasts three nights, O king, gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma.

verses.text:
शाकवृत्तिः फलैर्वापि कौमारं विन्दते पदम् ।
कण्वाश्रमं समासाद्य श्रीजुष्टं लोकपूजितम् ॥

meaning.en: Living on vegetables or fruit, he gains the state of Kumara. Reaching Kanva's hermitage, blessed with prosperity and honoured by the world,

verses.text:
धर्मारण्यं हि तत्पुण्यमाद्यं च भरतर्षभ ।
यत्र प्रविष्टमात्रो वै पापेभ्यो विप्रमुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: which is the holy and primeval Dharmaranya, best of the Bharatas, one is freed from sins merely on entering it.

verses.text:
अर्चयित्वा पितॄन्देवान्नियतो नियताशनः ।
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: Honouring ancestors and gods, restrained and with restrained diet, one gains the fruit of a sacrifice that fulfils all desires.

verses.text:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा ययातिपतनं व्रजेत् ।
हयमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति तत्र वै ॥

meaning.en: Then, after circling it, one should go to Yayati's Fall; there one gains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
महाकालं ततो गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः ।
कोटितीर्थमुपस्पृश्य हयमेधफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Then one should go to Mahakala, restrained and with restrained diet; having bathed at Kotitirtha one gains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ पुण्यस्थानमुमापतेः ।
नाम्ना भद्रवटं नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to the holy place of Uma's lord, known as Bhadravata, famous in the three worlds.

verses.text:
तत्राभिगम्य चेशानं गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ।
महादेवप्रसादाच्च गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: Going there to Ishana, one gains the fruit of a thousand cows, and by Mahadeva's grace attains leadership of Shiva's host.

verses.text:
नर्मदामथ चासाद्य नदीं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताम् ।
तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्देवानग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, reaching the Narmada, river famed in the three worlds, and offering water to ancestors and gods, one gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma.

verses.text:
दक्षिणं सिन्धुमासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः ।
अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति विमानं चाधिरोहति ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the southern Sindhu, a celibate who masters his senses gains the Agnishtoma and boards a celestial chariot.

verses.text:
चर्मण्वतीं समासाद्य नियतो नियताशनः ।
रन्तिदेवाभ्यनुज्ञातो अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the Charmanvati, restrained and with restrained diet, with Rantideva's blessing one gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ हिमवत्सुतमर्बुदम् ।
पृथिव्यां यत्र वै छिद्रं पूर्वमासीद्युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to Arbuda, son of the Himalaya, where in the past there was a rift in the earth, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
तत्राश्रमो वसिष्ठस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ।
तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: There is Vasishtha's hermitage, famed in the three worlds. Spending one night there, one gains the fruit of a thousand cows.

verses.text:
पिङ्गातीर्थमुपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः ।
कपिलानां नरव्याघ्र शतस्य फलमश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: Bathing at Pingatirtha, a celibate who has mastered his senses gains the fruit of a hundred tawny cows, tiger among men.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ प्रभासं लोकविश्रुतम् ।
यत्र संनिहितो नित्यं स्वयमेव हुताशनः ।
देवतानां मुखं वीर अनलोऽनिलसारथिः ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to the world-famous Prabhasa, where Agni himself is ever present, hero, the mouth of the gods, with the wind for his charioteer.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे स्नात्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः ।
अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there at that best of fords, pure and with a composed mind, a man gains the fruit of Agnishtoma and Atiratra sacrifices.

verses.text:
ततो गत्वा सरस्वत्याः सागरस्य च संगमे ।
गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य स्वर्गलोके महीयते ।
दीप्यमानोऽग्निवन्नित्यं प्रभया भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then going to the confluence of the Sarasvati and the sea, he gains the fruit of a thousand cows and is honoured in heaven, shining always like fire, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
त्रिरात्रमुषितस्तत्र तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः ।
प्रभासते यथा सोमो अश्वमेधं च विन्दति ॥

meaning.en: Staying three nights there and offering water to ancestors and gods, he shines like the moon and gains the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
वरदानं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं भरतसत्तम ।
विष्णोर्दुर्वाससा यत्र वरो दत्तो युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Then one should go to the ford Varadana, best of the Bharatas, where Durvasa gave Vishnu a boon, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
वरदाने नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ।
ततो द्वारवतीं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः ।
पिण्डारके नरः स्नात्वा लभेद्बहु सुवर्णकम् ॥

meaning.en: Bathing at Varadana, one gains the fruit of a thousand cows. Then, restrained and with restrained diet, one should go to Dvaravati; bathing at Pindaraka, one gains much gold.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाभाग पद्मलक्षणलक्षिताः ।
अद्यापि मुद्रा दृश्यन्ते तदद्भुतमरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: At that ford, great one, seals marked with lotuses are still seen today; that is a wonder, subduer of foes.

verses.text:
त्रिशूलाङ्कानि पद्मानि दृश्यन्ते कुरुनन्दन ।
महादेवस्य सांनिध्यं तत्रैव भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Lotuses stamped with tridents are seen there, joy of the Kurus. Mahadeva's presence is right there, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
सागरस्य च सिन्धोश्च संगमं प्राप्य भारत ।
तीर्थे सलिलराजस्य स्नात्वा प्रयतमानसः ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the confluence of the sea and the Sindhu, O Bharata, and bathing with a composed mind at the ford of the king of waters,

verses.text:
तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्देवानृषींश्च भरतर्षभ ।
प्राप्नोति वारुणं लोकं दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा ॥

meaning.en: and offering water to ancestors, gods and sages, best of the Bharatas, one reaches Varuna's world, shining with his own brilliance.

verses.text:
शङ्कुकर्णेश्वरं देवमर्चयित्वा युधिष्ठिर ।
अश्वमेधं दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Having worshipped the god Shankukarneshvara, Yudhishthira, one gains, the wise say, ten times the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य गच्छेत भरतर्षभ ।
तीर्थं कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् ।
दृमीति नाम्ना विख्यातं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम् ॥

meaning.en: After circling it, best of the Bharatas, one should go to a ford famed in the three worlds, named Drimi, which frees from all sins.

verses.text:
यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा उपासन्ते महेश्वरम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वार्चयित्वा च रुद्रं देवगणैर्वृतम् ।
जन्मप्रभृति पापानि कृतानि नुदते नरः ॥

meaning.en: There, where Brahma and the other gods worship Maheshvara, bathing and worshipping Rudra, surrounded by hosts of gods, a man wipes out the sins done from birth.

verses.text:
दृमी चात्र नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुता ।
तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र हयमेधमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: Here too, best of men, the Drimi is praised by all the gods. Bathing there, tiger among men, one gains the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
जित्वा यत्र महाप्राज्ञ विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ।
पुरा शौचं कृतं राजन्हत्वा दैवतकण्टकान् ॥

meaning.en: There, O wise king, Vishnu the all-powerful once won victory and performed his purification after killing those who were thorns to the gods.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ वसोर्धारामभिष्टुताम् ।
गमनादेव तस्यां हि हयमेधमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to the praised Vasudhara; merely by going there one gains the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
स्नात्वा कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ प्रयतात्मा तु मानवः ।
तर्प्य देवान्पितॄंश्चैव विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there, best of the Kurus, a man of controlled mind, offering water to gods and ancestors, is honoured in Vishnu's world.

verses.text:
तीर्थं चात्र परं पुण्यं वसूनां भरतर्षभ ।
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च वसूनां संमतो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Here there is also a supremely holy ford of the Vasus, best of the Bharatas; bathing and drinking there, one becomes beloved of the Vasus.

verses.text:
सिन्धूत्तममिति ख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ लभेद्बहु सुवर्णकम् ॥

meaning.en: Famed as Sindhuttama, destroyer of all sins, there, best of men, one who bathes gains much gold.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मतुङ्गं समासाद्य शुचिः प्रयतमानसः ।
ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति सुकृती विरजा नरः ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Brahmatunga, pure and with a controlled mind, a man of good deeds, free of passion, reaches Brahma's world.

verses.text:
कुमारिकाणां शक्रस्य तीर्थं सिद्धनिषेवितम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः क्षिप्रं शक्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: The ford of the maidens, Shakra's ford, is frequented by siddhas. Bathing there, a man quickly reaches Indra's world.

verses.text:
रेणुकायाश्च तत्रैव तीर्थं देवनिषेवितम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वा भवेद्विप्रो विमलश्चन्द्रमा यथा ॥

meaning.en: Right there is also Renuka's ford, frequented by gods. Bathing there, a brahmin becomes spotless like the moon.

verses.text:
अथ पञ्चनदं गत्वा नियतो नियताशनः ।
पञ्च यज्ञानवाप्नोति क्रमशो येऽनुकीर्तिताः ॥

meaning.en: Then, going to Panchanada, restrained and with restrained diet, one gains in turn the five sacrifices already described.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ भीमायाः स्थानमुत्तमम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वा तु योन्यां वै नरो भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to Bhima's excellent place; bathing there, best of the Bharatas, in the yoni,

verses.text:
देव्याः पुत्रो भवेद्राजंस्तप्तकुण्डलविग्रहः ।
गवां शतसहस्रस्य फलं चैवाप्नुयान्महत् ॥

meaning.en: a man, O king, becomes the Goddess's son, with a body like refined gold in earrings, and gains the great fruit of a hundred thousand cows.

verses.text:
गिरिमुञ्जं समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् ।
पितामहं नमस्कृत्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Girimunja, famous in the three worlds, and bowing to the Grandfather, one gains the fruit of a thousand cows.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ विमलं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ।
अद्यापि यत्र दृश्यन्ते मत्स्याः सौवर्णराजताः ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go to the excellent ford Vimala, where golden and silver fish are seen even today.

verses.text:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरश्रेष्ठ वाजपेयमवाप्नुयात् ।
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा गच्छेच्च परमां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there, best of men, one gains the Vajapeya; with the self cleansed of all sins, one reaches the highest state.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत मलदां त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम् ।
पश्चिमायां तु संध्यायामुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Then one should go to Maladaa, famed in the three worlds, and in the western twilight, after rinsing the mouth by the rules,

verses.text:
चरुं नरेन्द्र सप्तार्चेर्यथाशक्ति निवेदयेत् ।
पितॄणामक्षयं दानं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: offer a pot of cooked offering to the seven-flamed Agni as best one can, O king. The wise say it is an imperishable gift to the ancestors.

verses.text:
गवां शतसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च ।
अश्वमेधसहस्रेण श्रेयान्सप्तार्चिषश्चरुः ॥

meaning.en: Agni's offering is better than a hundred thousand cows, a hundred Rajasuyas or a thousand horse sacrifices.

verses.text:
ततो निवृत्तो राजेन्द्र वस्त्रापदमथाविशेत् ।
अभिगम्य महादेवमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Returning from there, O king of kings, one should enter Vastrapada; having gone to Mahadeva, one gains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
मणिमन्तं समासाद्य ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः ।
एकरात्रोषितो राजन्नग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Manimant, a celibate with composed mind, staying one night, O king, gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma.

verses.text:
अथ गच्छेत राजेन्द्र देविकां लोकविश्रुताम् ।
प्रसूतिर्यत्र विप्राणां श्रूयते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then, king of kings, one should go to the world-famed Devika, where the origin of brahmins is said to lie, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
त्रिशूलपाणेः स्थानं च त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् ।
देविकायां नरः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: And the place of the trident-bearer there is famed in the three worlds. Bathing in the Devika and worshipping Maheshvara,

verses.text:
यथाशक्ति चरुं तत्र निवेद्य भरतर्षभ ।
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलम् ॥

meaning.en: and offering a pot of cooked food there as best one can, best of the Bharatas, one gains the fruit of a sacrifice that fulfils all desires.

verses.text:
कामाख्यं तत्र रुद्रस्य तीर्थं देवर्षिसेवितम् ।
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमाप्नोति भारत ॥

meaning.en: There is Rudra's ford called Kamakhya, frequented by divine sages. Bathing there, O Bharata, a man quickly attains success.

verses.text:
यजनं याजनं गत्वा तथैव ब्रह्मवालुकाम् ।
पुष्पन्यास उपस्पृश्य न शोचेन्मरणं ततः ॥

meaning.en: Going to Yajana, Yajana and Brahmavaluka, and bathing at Pushpanyasa, one need not grieve about death.

verses.text:
अर्धयोजनविस्तारां पञ्चयोजनमायताम् ।
एतावद्देविकामाहुः पुण्यां देवर्षिसेविताम् ॥

meaning.en: They say the holy Devika, frequented by divine sages, is half a yojana wide and five yojanas long.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ दीर्घसत्रं यथाक्रमम् ।
यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।
दीर्घसत्रमुपासन्ते दक्षिणाभिर्यतव्रताः ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go in order to Dirghasatra, where Brahma and the other gods, siddhas and great sages of firm vows worship with fees at the long sacrifice.

verses.text:
गमनादेव राजेन्द्र दीर्घसत्रमरिंदम ।
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: Merely by going to Dirghasatra, O king and subduer of foes, a man gains the fruit of the Rajasuya and the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
ततो विनशनं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः ।
गच्छत्यन्तर्हिता यत्र मरुपृष्ठे सरस्वती ।
चमसे च शिवोद्भेदे नागोद्भेदे च दृश्यते ॥

meaning.en: Then, restrained and with restrained diet, one should go to Vinashana, where the Sarasvati disappears into the desert's back, and is seen again at Chamasa, Shivodbheda and Nagodbheda.

verses.text:
स्नात्वा च चमसोद्भेदे अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ।
शिवोद्भेदे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Bathing at Chamasodbheda one gains the fruit of the Agnishtoma; bathing at Shivodbheda one gains the fruit of a thousand cows.

verses.text:
नागोद्भेदे नरः स्नात्वा नागलोकमवाप्नुयात् ।
शशयानं च राजेन्द्र तीर्थमासाद्य दुर्लभम् ।
शशरूपप्रतिच्छन्नाः पुष्करा यत्र भारत ॥

meaning.en: Bathing at Nagodbheda one reaches the world of the nagas. And, king of kings, reaching the rare ford Shashayana, where the lotuses are hidden in the form of hares,

verses.text:
सरस्वत्यां महाराज अनु संवत्सरं हि ते ।
स्नायन्ते भरतश्रेष्ठ वृत्तां वै कार्त्तिकीं सदा ॥

meaning.en: people bathe in the Sarasvati there every year, great king, best of the Bharatas, always on the full moon of Kartika.

verses.text:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र द्योतते शशिवत्सदा ।
गोसहस्रफलं चैव प्राप्नुयाद्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there, tiger among men, one always shines like the moon and gains the fruit of a thousand cows, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
कुमारकोटिमासाद्य नियतः कुरुनन्दन ।
तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः ।
गवामयमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Kumarakoti, restrained, joy of the Kurus, one should bathe there, devoted to honouring ancestors and gods; one gains the Gavamaya and uplifts one's family.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत धर्मज्ञ रुद्रकोटिं समाहितः ।
पुरा यत्र महाराज ऋषिकोटिः समाहिता ।
प्रहर्षेण च संविष्टा देवदर्शनकाङ्क्षया ॥

meaning.en: Then, knower of dharma, one should go with a composed mind to Rudrakoti, where in the past a crore of sages assembled, great king, filled with joy and wishing to see the god.

verses.text:
अहं पूर्वमहं पूर्वं द्रक्ष्यामि वृषभध्वजम् ।
एवं संप्रस्थिता राजन्नृषयः किल भारत ॥

meaning.en: "I will see the bull-bannered god first! I first!" So, king, O Bharata, the sages set out.

verses.text:
ततो योगेश्वरेणापि योगमास्थाय भूपते ।
तेषां मन्युप्रणाशार्थमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord of yoga, taking to yoga, to calm the anger of those pure-minded sages, O king,

verses.text:
सृष्टा कोटिस्तु रुद्राणामृषीणामग्रतः स्थिता ।
मया पूर्वतरं दृष्ट इति ते मेनिरे पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: created a crore of Rudras who stood before the sages. Each sage thought, "I saw him first."

verses.text:
तेषां तुष्टो महादेव ऋषीणामुग्रतेजसाम् ।
भक्त्या परमया राजन्वरं तेषां प्रदिष्टवान् ।
अद्य प्रभृति युष्माकं धर्मवृद्धिर्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Mahadeva, pleased with those sages of fierce splendour and their supreme devotion, O king, granted them a boon: "From today your dharma will grow."

verses.text:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र रुद्रकोट्यां नरः शुचिः ।
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥

meaning.en: Bathing at Rudrakoti, tiger among men, a pure man gains the horse sacrifice and uplifts his family.

verses.text:
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र संगमं लोकविश्रुतम् ।
सरस्वत्या महापुण्यमुपासन्ते जनार्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, king of kings, one should go to the world-famed confluence of the Sarasvati, very holy, where people worship Janardana.

verses.text:
यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः ।
अभिगच्छन्ति राजेन्द्र चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दशीम् ॥

meaning.en: There Brahma and the other gods, sages, siddhas and charanas gather, O king of kings, on the fourteenth of the bright half of Chaitra.

verses.text:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र विन्देद्बहु सुवर्णकम् ।
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there, tiger among men, one gains much gold and, with the self purified of all sin, goes to Brahma's world.

verses.text:
ऋषीणां यत्र सत्राणि समाप्तानि नराधिप ।
सत्रावसानमासाद्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: Where the sages' sacrifices were completed, O ruler of men, reaching the Satravasana ford one gains the fruit of a thousand cows.
